name: Outsiders
source:
In this game, you face a dreamy loser that has recently been transferred to "Windsor Academy" a weird-but fancy school in which you'll encounter the hardest game in the world: Survive high school and find love.

But off-course, this will not be an easy task, as each one of the characters has its past, and some of them may hide some dark secrets. Once you have discovered the secrets of the girls... well... I guess you can date em.
translation:
在这款游戏中，你面对的是一个梦想中的失败者，他最近被转移到“温莎学院”，这是一所奇怪但华丽的学校，你将在其中遇到世界上最艰难的游戏：在高中生存并找到爱情。

但当然，这并不是一件容易的事，因为每个角色都有自己的过去，其中一些人可能隐藏着一些黑暗的秘密。一旦你发现了女孩们的秘密……好吧……我想你可以和她们约会。
